meta.sample_notice: SAMPLE documents contain invented identities only; any resemblance is coincidental.
meta.scope: Metadata only. PDF Info and catalog/Info XMP; PDF outline titles and annotation /T authors and link URIs; DOCX core.xml, app.xml, custom.xml, comment and tracked-change authors and initials, and absolute paths or emails in properties, relationship targets, and field codes. Bookmark titles are flagged for a file name, an email, an absolute path, or a trailing CV marker, including nested bookmarks. An http or https link is flagged when a path segment starts with ~user. Not checked: page text, headers, footers, logos, fonts, ordinary section headings, a bookmark that only names a person, or a percent-encoded %7E in place of that tilde. A pass is not a submission clearance.
meta.rule_basis: NASA SMD DAPR lists document properties and PDF bookmarks that reveal the PI as a common pitfall, and FAQ A11 says to redact metadata that could identify the team or institution (kb/raw/nasa_dapr.html). Non-empty author fields, including a PDF annotation /T, are flagged. Bookmark titles are flagged when they contain a file name, an email, an absolute path, or a trailing curriculum-vitae marker; ordinary section titles and a bare personal name are not. An http or https link whose path contains a ~user segment is flagged as a path. That match is a heuristic, not a name roster, and a %7E encoding is not matched. Creating-application names, nonstandard Info keys, emails, paths, file-name bookmarks, and CV-marker bookmarks are heuristics, not quoted program rules.
meta.redaction: First character and total character count only; no raw finding values.

findings.why: Non-empty core property. A reviewer can open it from document properties.
Non-empty core property. A reviewer can open it from document properties.
Non-empty comment author. A reviewer sees this name on the comment, not in document properties.
Non-empty tracked-change author. A reviewer sees this name on the revision markup, not in document properties.
Non-empty PDF Info field. A reviewer can open it from the Info dictionary.
Non-empty PDF annotation title. A reviewer sees this name on the comment.
Absolute path, file:// URL, home-directory path, or an http(s) URL with a ~user path segment, in metadata, a relationship target, a field code, a bookmark title, or a link URI.
Non-empty XMP field. A reviewer can open it from the embedded metadata packet.

Bookmark title contains a file name. Merged-file outlines often carry a person's or institution's file name. Heuristic: ordinary section titles are not flagged. The saved DAPR page names bookmarks but does not define this pattern.

Bookmark title ends with a curriculum-vitae marker. Nested outlines are included. Heuristic: ordinary section titles are not flagged, and a bare personal name with no file name, email, path, or CV marker still passes. The saved DAPR page names bookmarks but does not define this pattern.
